name: Ig2_Facet_Sphere_ScGeom
description: Create/update a ScGeom instance representing intersection of Facet and Sphere. Denoting $u_n$ the corresponding overlap<ScGeom.penetrationDepth>, $\vec{C}$ the contact point<ScGeom.contactPoint> and $\vec{n}$ the contact normal<ScGeom.normal> while $\vec{S}$ stands for sphere's center, $\vec{H}$...

attributes.name: shrinkFactor
attributes.description: The radius of the inscribed circle of the facet is decreased by the value of the sphere's radius multiplied by *shrinkFactor*. From the definition of contact point on the surface made of facets, the given surface is not continuous and becomes in effect surface covered with triangular tiles, with gap between the separate tiles equal to the sphere's radius multiplied by 2×*shrinkFactor*. If zero, no shrinking is done.

attributes.name: hertzian
attributes.description: The equivalent radius for the Facet (ScGeom.refR1) is chosen as 1e8 times the Sphere's radius (closer to Hertzian therory, where it is infinite).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.
